text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A randomised call centre experiment found a 13 percent increase in completed calls among remote staff.","cited_pids":["remote_work#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The 13 percent call centre gain was attributed to a quieter environment and fewer breaks.","cited_pids":["remote_work#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Output per engineer measured by completed tickets held steady or improved after full transitions to distributed work in several large technology firms.","cited_pids":["remote_work#3"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Remote arrangements reduce employee attrition.","cited_pids":["remote_work#2"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A large field experiment found remote data entry workers were 18 percent less productive than office counterparts on identical tasks.","cited_pids":["remote_work#6"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Studies of software teams report slower onboarding and weaker mentoring for junior employees after remote work.","cited_pids":["remote_work#4"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Communication becomes more siloed after a transition to remote work.","cited_pids":["remote_work#5"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Self-reported productivity gains from remote work often do not appear in objective output measures.","cited_pids":["remote_work#7"]}]}
